1996:
1. Cast Spells (Arrow Rain and Snowstorm) against the enemy invaders. Win Defender's Emblems and other rewards every time you wipe out the enemies. Defender's Emblems can be exchanged for items at the Event Shop. Any remaining Defender's Emblems will be removed after the event ends.
2. During the event, each player can cast the [Arrow Rain] Spell 3 times a day for free.
3. Each Spell cast has a small chance to deal a devastating blow that results in an immediate Wipeout of the enemies.
4. If you leave your Guild during the event, your Wipeout contribution will be deducted from that Guild's Wipeout count (this will not affect Guild Achievements).
5. On the last day of the event, you will only be able to view the leaderboard and exchange for rewards. 
6. After the event, the system will rank and send rewards to players and Guilds based on the number of Wipeouts they achieved. In cases where the Wipeout count is the same, the player who reached that Wipeout count first will be ranked higher. 
7. Guild members must cast a Spell during the event to receive Guild Rank rewards.
8. Each player may achieve up to 1,000 Wipeouts per day.

1. You can challenge the Epic Hero 2 times a day. Challenge chances reset at 00:00 server time. You can spend Gems to get 2 additional challenge chances every day.
2. Epic Heroes can be challenged in increasing order of difficulty. After defeating the current Epic Hero, the next difficulty will be open to challenge.
3. Your challenge chance will not be deducted when you successfully challenge the Epic Hero. If you fail a challenge, 1 challenge chance will be deducted but the Epic Hero's HP will not be restored, so you can continue the challenge by deploying Heroes.
4. Before starting the challenge, you can spend Gems to weaken the Epic Hero (reduces the Hero's Lv and their Talent, Enchantment, and Insignia level). Each Epic Hero can be weakened up to 4 times. If the Epic Hero is challenged but not defeated, you can reset them to let them recover to full HP but with their level weakened. If you choose not to reset and let the Epic Hero recover HP, you cannot continue to weaken them.
5. Warden Skills are not applicable in battles in this event. However, Warden Star Grid bonuses and effects are applicable.

36257:
1. A new season opens every alternate week and lasts an entire week each time. The top 6,500 ranked Guilds may participate in the event.
2. The Torch Battle event consists of three phases: Trial, Layout, and Conclusion.
- Phase 1 (Trial Phase) lasts 2 days. Every Guild member selects their desired difficulty to challenge the trial. (You must clear the prior difficulty first before you can select the next difficulty in future seasons.) Clearing the trial awards the corresponding number of Torches and other rewards such as resources and items. The difficulty cannot be changed in the current season once it is set. During the challenge, you can select a guildmate's assisting Hero to help you in the battle. You cannot select the same assisting Hero again after you win a challenge.
- Phase 2 (Layout Phase) lasts 1 day. A certain number of defense buildings are activated based on the total number of Torches your Guild obtained in phase 1. Use these defense buildings to form a defense layout. To aid your defense, select any guildmate's assisting Hero to place on one Hero Base. Towers' ATK and HP are based on Hero Base Heroes' ATK and HP.  
- Phase 3 (Conclusion Phase) lasts 1 day. Groups of 8 Guilds each will be formed to commence Torch capturing. Grouping is based on each Guild's Might and total number of Torches. In Torch capturing, the more total Torches your Guild has, the greater your Torch Bonus and effects. If your Torch Bonus is low, your Heroes can die in this phase's battles. (Hero deaths in this phase will not affect other gameplay.) You can select 1 assisting Hero to aid you in battle. You cannot select the same assisting Hero again after they help you win the battle or they die.
3. Matchmaking in phase 3 is based on your Guild's Might and total number of Torches.
4. For phase 1 and 3, every guild member can deploy 1 Hero to assist, who can help guildmates in Torch Battle. Once deployed, you can't change your assisting Hero nor use them for your own Torch Battle play throughout this season.
5. Guild members will not be able to participate in an ongoing Torch Battle under the following conditions: Guild is created during the season (all Guild members won't be able to participate); guild member joined the Guild while Torch Battle is ongoing; guild member did not obtain any Torches in phase 1 (Trial Phase).

3. In phase 3: Earn Prestige and Gems based on the final tally of Torches obtained by your Guild, your Guild's grouping and ranking within the group, your ranking among your guildmates, etc.

100001: The Engineer gets his ungodly power from sweet, sweet rum. He'll crush the next fool in line who dares challenge him.
100002: The grim, glacial touch of the Frost Witch torments both her and her foes, for these are the very same hands that turned her loved ones into ice sculptures.
100003: The Alchemist may look to be all brains because he is. This is a nerd you won't want to pick on.
100004: Don't be fooled by the harmless facade of this stumpy barrel. Hardened by many battles, the Marauder is a superb tank that gives great DMG-reduction boosts.
100005: Dryad, through an unceasing effort at communion, now shares an intimate bond with Mother Nature. It is now the source of her formidable constitution.
100006: Usually in deep stupor, Hill Giants hate to be disturbed. Those who wake one must brace themselves for an avalanche of rocks hurled towards their way.
100007: The Marksman always strives to perfect her aim. Her arrows are shot with such power that they often split, hitting other nearby foes.
100008: Angel was sent from the heavens above to train in the mortal world. Her healing skills make her an invaluable asset on the battlefield.
100009: Seconds away from the blade, this deathrow convict retaliated and turned the tables on his executioner. Impressed, the reigning lord made him the new Executioner.
100010: The only female of her craft, the Assassin works to keep her true identity a secret. We only know that she from the land of arrggghhh...
100011: He had always wondered, “Am I wolf? Or am I human?” His quest for answers only left him with more questions. His confusion led to frustration, and... you will not like him when he's frustrated.
100012: A warrior from a far away land left his hometown in search of a lost technique. His adventure brought him to this foreign world where he astounds his enemies with his martial arts.
100013:
The Cyclopes have a unique ritual: Once they’re of age, they’ll leave their homes in search of something special... a weapon unique to only themselves.
"I’ll smash you to smithereens!"
100014:
Although a child by most standards, Shaman is the exceptional leader of a mysterious tribe of witch doctors. His hobby is to curse others.
"How’s my mask?"
100015: Once a beloved retainer of a powerful pharaoh, she was sacrificed to continue serving him in the afterlife. She made a deal with the God of death, allowing her to return to the land of the living. The cost? A serpent’s tail for legs.
100016: A student who broke the laws of magic practitioners and was banished from the northern lands. He gained immense power, but his body turned into that of a demon.
100017: Triton is one of the few merfolk still left in this world. Even with a war going on, he couldn't care less if everything around him went up in flames... He just wants to find his lover again...
100018: Personal bodyguard to Valentina. He shares a close bond with her and was bestowed the title Paladin.
100019: The Ninja is the top assassin in the guild and never misses his mark. Rumors say he comes from a far away kingdom. Nobody has ever seen him at work, for all who have are dead.
100020: Tired of being at her summoner's beck and call, the Succubus struck him down and walked free. She now goes where she pleases.
100021: This red-bearded guy can be slumped over a table in a tavern, completely drunk at times. But when the moment comes, he'll spring up, grab his axe, and surprise you with his immense strength.
100022: The Druid has traveled far and wide and rescued countless souls. In return, nature has given him immense power that manifests whenever his life is in danger.
100023: A lonely spirit wandering the Lost Realm. Perhaps your next summoning spell will release it from the realm and set it free.
100024: The Thunder God hails from a separate plane, where Gods fight for the right to rule. He lost to his siblings and hence wandered to this place...
100025: There are rumors that the Pumpkin Duke isn't a person at all, but an empty shell filled with the souls of Halloween tricksters. Do you believe that?
100026: Huge piles of ore went missing in a string of mysterious incidents at the rare mineral mines. "And the culprit was a giant ore-eating scorpion. Ya believe me?" The old man shudders as he recalls the terrifying monster.
100027: A lonely old man created this round little fella for company. But one day, while he was out working with his deer, the mischevious Snowzilla snuck onto the old man's sled...
100028:
The high and mighty Reaper is in a rage, for a mortal has dared escape death. 
"Death comes to all. Sinner, I shall drag you back to my realm!"
100029: He may look like a child, but he's actually an old God who decided to visit the mortal realm. He wanders about in aimless whimsy.
100030: The most powerful pharaoh of all time was entombed with a large number of sacrifices. Now, with the aid of dark magic, he has risen again to terrorize the mortal realm.
100031: An unfortunate childhood accident left the Minotaur Chieftain with really bad eyesight, but don't underestimate him! He's still lethal on the battlefield...
100032: I am the last. They have hunted us for centuries, taken our land, perverted our young. I am the last. And I will survive!
100033: Not much is known about Aries. Some say he was already old when the land was young and has an irrational fear of ducks. All we know is, he has a cousin who is very good at driving chariots.
100034: "Just because I'm pale doesn't mean I'm weak."
100035: When he was young, Orksbane was teased by his friends and family for his purple skin. Orksbane, who has a very heavy axe, is now the last of his kind.
100036: Santa's been upset ever since his herd of temperamental reindeer ran away from home. He searches for them all year round, except during Christmas due to work commitments.
100037: Everyone in Pixie's clan knew she was blessed with magical powers. After muttering to herself one day, she left to venture into the unknown. Had she received a foretelling?
100038: The Death Knight was a gifted man who outshone his elder brother, the Paladin, in every way. But alas, arrogance has consumed him, driving his lust for more power.
100039: Tribespeople found this creature beached and rescued her. Since then, she protects the tribe in repayment. Although the Siren has no recollection of her past, her expressionless demeanor prompts others to wonder what she has seen...
100040: Deemed a bane by humans and elves alike, the Destroyer was banished to Hell by those who feared him. He has now returned to wreak havoc on the land once again.
100041: As Honorary Magister of the royal family, the Warlock is highly proficient in the art of flame magic. He devoted his life to magic research and invented his very own spell that combines attack and defense into one.
100042: Long ago, a sapling witnessed much destruction within the woods. Fueled by an unwavering sense of duty, the young tree grew to become a powerful sentinel of its forest home.
100043: Descended from a line of winged guardians, the Harpy Queen was born to keep her homeland safe. Yet her heart is in turmoil, struggling between duty and the desire to be free.
100044: Cursed to remain among the living, this undead knight wanders the land, looking for someone to finally put him to rest.
100045: Nothing is too challenging for this wily pirate. Rumor has it that he wears the hook and eye patch merely for looks!
100046: Ghoulem was but another statue decorating a castle's perimeter, until a scarlet gem granted it life and arcane power. The question remains, what will it do with its newfound capabilities?
100047: Candy Kane's exquisite beauty masks her devious personality. Is she your friend or foe? It's like deciding between a rock and a hard place, really...
100048:
I hunt. It thinks it can hide from me. I will find it. I will sniff it out. I will snuff out the flame.
Wait, that heat...
It is here!
100049: Famously reticent, Valentina is the very definition of a silent guardian. She will defend you with every fiber of her being, but you'd be lucky to hear two words from her.
100050: Surprisingly quick and nimble, this undead spirit went insane after countless millenia of his beard pulling at his face. He is, quite literally, dying for a shave.
100051: The Beast Tamer dedicated his life to mastering animals, so much so that even he has forgotten his real name. Like everyone else, he refers to himself as Beast Tamer.
100052:
On a whim, an old monk taught kung fu to a monkey. That monkey went on to tear up a legendary league, hoard orange stones, and fight purple space aliens. Now, the Kungfu Master travels the land, searching for his infamous student.
"Anyone seen a monkey with a stick?"
100053: Mount Jufi is a famous volcano in the far east, active for a thousand years. Out of a cataclysmic eruption that shook the continent emerged the Juggernaut. The alchemical runes etched unto its body suggests it was created. How or why remains a mystery. As it became sentient, it also acquired an insatiable hatred for all humanoids. That hatred drove the Juggernaut's rampage into the mainland, bringing with it, the explosive wrath of Mount Jufi.
100054: Phantom Fighter hails from a land steeped in mysticism. She looks cute as a button, hair buns and all, but her flaming phantom swords can seal magic, and wreak a good dose of havoc. Silent but deadly.
100055:
A divine monkey born from a magical rock, his immense strength and speed makes him a fearsome warrior. An everlasting search for more powerful opponents has drawn him to the clashes of the land.
"That was easy, who's next?"
100056: Teaching about the light may seem like an ideal task for a priest’s daughter, but she has something a little different in mind. Armed with a giant cross, she prefers a more hands-on approach to spreading the word.
100057: Lady Leo hails from a starry realm beyond our own, where gods and goddesses battle for the right to rule. She occasionally joins in mortal conflicts simply for the thrill of battle. She's often seen riding through the clouds, lightning trailing behind her majestic steed and a wild-eyed grin upon her face.
100058: It takes a true madman to sell his soul in exchange for power. Whatever name he had before, Grimfiend is that madman now. But the demon that he carries within him desires more than souls. It also craves a scarlet gem said to bring unnatural life to unnatural things...
100059: Only one person has ever befriended the dragons, and that is Dracax. Unwavering in the face of danger, he alone has displayed the true strength and courage needed to win the dragons' friendship. Dracax is never seen without his faithful friend by his side. Watch out for this deadly duo, because they'll attack where your defenses are weakest!
100060: In ancient times, there was a woman so beautiful, her family was slaughtered so that a jealous king could have her as his wife. In her despair, she prayed to the gods for the strength to slay her captor, but it was a demon who answered her pleas. He took her beauty and gave her unspeakable power. So goes the legend of Medusa...
100061: Insanely wild due to its fractured minds, Demogorgon is an unworldly being from beyond the planes. Though it bears a resemblance to the dragons Moltanica and Arctica, its form is a mere facade of the Demogorgon's true, shapeless, demonic form.
100062: Trixie Treat possessed magical powers even as an infant. She was found abandoned in a field of pumpkins, where her cries enchanted the crop and awakened an ancient spirit. The two had been inseparable since, until the latter's sudden and mysterious disappearance.
100063: What once was is no more. Memories of the great empire have long faded into history. But the Revenant's spirit stays strong within the confines of his undead flesh. Intruders who dare set foot on his lands will find themselves punished without mercy.
100064:
Lil' Nick sulked and pouted when he was told to stay home. The moment the old man vanished into the snowstorm, Lil' Nick turned around and rummaged for his hidden stash. With a bell in one hand and an overfilled sack in the other, he left the homely cabin while declaring: 
"Just you wait! I'll show you how festive I can be!"
100065: He fought, wept and bled in an eternal war against evil. Yet for all his devotion, he was betrayed and exiled by his brethren. With nothing but his spear and divine blood left, Michael set out on a journey of vengeance.
100066: An engineering prodigy, the Heartbreaker has won the hearts of many back home with life-changing inventions. Now, she wishes to change her own life as she embarks upon a journey to seek her missing father...
100067: For centuries, Anubis was bound by forbidden magic to serve a pharoah's lust for power. But his captor was no god; mortality claimed him. And after many years, Anubis regained its strength to break free from the spell. Now it walks the earth again, eager to unleash its wrath upon the mortal world.
100068: The Ronin is a mysterious man from the Far East... A warrior without a master, traveling across the land with nothing more than his sword and armor. Rumors of his skills spread wherever he goes. Many claim that his strikes are so swift that they cannot be seen. None who have challenged the lone swordsman live to tell their tale.
100069: A thief with the prettiest face and the greediest heart, disappeared after a great heist. Rumors have it that the Heartbreaker's prototype weapons were found among the loot. Shortly after, a young bounty hunter with the prettiest face and the greediest heart, began to fire up the battlefield...
100070: Highly territorial and short-tempered, Rockno would charge at anything in a blind rage. It's best to steer clear of this irritable creature, lest you meet the wrong end of a horn, hoof, or hammer!
100071: An assistant in the royal alchemy lab, she had a keen interest in machines despite her lack of talent. It was by pure accident that she discovered how to power up an old, rusty robot. Fortunately, that didn't stop her mentor from giving her a gold star.
100072: Long ago, there was a battle between a million soldiers and a fire-breathing dragon. The dragon massacred the army, but it too succumbed to its wounds and died among the corpses. Nothing survived the slaughter that day, but the souls on that field were restless. For centuries they possessed the remains of their killer, until it rose as an undead abomination.
100073: Unleashed by a tribal blood ritual, this mysterious creature desires a vessel fit for its soul. Drawn to his black magic, it possesses the body and powers of a witch doctor, all while its true form hides in plain sight.
100074: In a desperate attempt to prove his genius, a man performed a series of experiments on himself. But the strength-enhancing procedures went awry...
100075: Long the silent guardian of the righteous, Athene is no longer content with struggling behind the scenes. She now fights to right the wrongs of the land and bring about true peace.
100076: Santa's not-so-little helper. The jolly old man insisted that the creature help spread the joy of Christmas while he continued to search for his reindeer. "Think about the children," he would plead until the beast finally came out of hiding. Two long years have passed since then, and the Sasquatch had intended to return home. Little did it expect a beautiful fairy to thaw its heart...
100077: A guide for the spirits in the Lost Realm. After countless days and nights spent in the company of spirits, she decided to seal a contract with a deity of the Lost Realm, release all those bound to summoning spells, and guide them to freedom.
100078: A meeting with Cupid, brought about by her Love Dove, led Dove Keeper to begin training as a rookie god of love under Cupid's guidance. Dove Keeper loves to seek and create beautiful love stories, but has never used her powers on herself. Instead of weaving her own tale, she prefers to let the future bring her a love story.
100079: Cirrina, Queen of the Abyss, watched over the depths until she was stirred by the rumblings of a sea monster. Suspecting forces from the land above were causing her prisoner's restlessness, she surfaced from the dark waters to investigate.
100080: He was once Thunder God's disciple, but his abilities surpassed even his master's. His arrogance grew with his immense talent, and, coupled with his obsession for dominance, formed the perfect storm for others to manipulate. Darkness now clouds his mind as he turns against his old master...
100081:
"Who knew that a stalk of sage, two drops of pomegranate juice, and a clump of mud would be components for frog creation?!"
Ribbit had a penchant for science despite being raised by a shaman elder. She experimented with wild plants and creatures to create poisons of varying degrees of deadliness.
100082: Having grown up in the Burning Ravine, Lavanica developed the power of magma despite not being one of the flame dragons. As a descendant of the ancient wyrms who have watched the continent form and grow, it too will continue to watch over the future of the land.
100083: Asura destroyed a prosperous empire in the Silent Hills on the order of a mysterious force, only to discover his Blood Gem stolen. Angered by this betrayal, Asura drew his swords and gathered the remaining power of his gem within him. All who stand between him and his prized gem will fall.
100084: A dangerous experiment with ancient magic engulfed Ma Hatma in elemental ice. Instead of succumbing to her fate in the freezing cold, she used her mastery of magic to fuse her body with the ice and gained tremendous magical power. Eager to climb ever higher in the realm of ice magic, she shunned the rest of the world and headed off to the icy tundra alone, pursuing a new fate.
100085: Once innocent children who led an idyllic life on the streets, these youngsters were forced to grow up when war destroyed their home. To survive, they had to learn to fight.
100086: Cunning and wicked, he is the terrifying manifestation of evil thoughts and actions. Rumors have it that only one who has full repentance from sin can defeat him.
100087: Born into a family of pirates, she has no problem using her cute looks to get her way. When war broke out, her ambition spurred her to join the navy, where her seafaring skills helped her rise through the ranks. She helms her fleet in a style that is in equal parts confident and devious.
100088: A phoenix that resurrected not from fire, but ice. Through a magical rock, the ancient bird commands the power to create lands of snow and frost. Its vast power drew the intrepid adventurers to hunt it, but none succeeded due to its elusiveness and harsh habitat. But as war spread throughout the land, the legendary bird could no longer remain hidden. Furious of the denizens' warmongering ways, it vowed to bury the chaos under a relentless blizzard so that life in Narcia may start anew.
100089:
"Me. So. Angry!"
This giant root vegetable was uprooted when the war swept across its homeland. In battle, its determination to protect others outweighs its lack of wit and agility. It can also call upon the forces of nature to fend off its foes.
100090: Born into aristocracy, she is hailed for her beauty and her expertise in the arts of war. Although young, she has already amassed epic victories that will cement her place in history. Her esteemed military career in the Royal Capital is the envy of many generals, while her looks draw even more admirers. On the battlefield, she is elegant and dangerous, like a rose with all its thorns.
100091: Labeled a coward for abandoning the battlefield, Cosmo refuses to tell his side of the story. Strangely, whatever meekness he has seems to vanish when he holds his staff. He becomes a fearless chaperone, guiding souls into the Lost Realm. Cosmo gazes silently at the staff for long periods, observing every twist of its energy. Perhaps he sees something that others do not...
100092: Ripper's unbreakable claws and intense spirit make him a natural fighter. While he is eager to battle to the death (read: tear opponents to pieces), everyone flees in fright at the mere sight of him. This leaves him little choice but to wander alone, longing for a satisfying fight.
100093: Brawny and brave, he is proud to defend the helpless against evildoers. His noble cause attracted needy refugees... and a fair share of swooning admirers. Fortunately, his natural reddish complexion helps to hide his blushing, as he does his best to maintain a tough image.
100094: According to legend, Zephyrica was a guardian of the Barren Sands. Denizens believed he had created the desert winds, even while he lay dormant for millennia. The legend also foretold that when he awakened, he would summon relentless whirlwinds to destroy opposing empires, and rule over Narcia from the Barren Sands.
100095: Fascinated by his folk tales and mystical spells, the children of Voodoo Village gather around the Occultist in his dwelling. While keen to share his knowledge and demonstrate his conjuring skills, he must clean his home of poisonous materials for hours before each session.
100096: He is the personification of Fear. Blood runs cold at his presence, while eerie whispers and laughter drain the last shred of sanity. His victims live on in unending fear - a fate worse than death.
100097: Queen Wasp rules the Ancient Forest with a thorny disposition, striking fear and commanding admiration in equal measure. She leads her subjects decisively, and insists the weak and weak-willed are trained until they become able warriors. The denizens of these woods - many of them shy and gentle - are assured their home is protected under the reign of their solemn queen.
100098:
He once "persuaded" a clerk from the Royal Capital to write his biography. Titled "Memoirs of a Handsome Gunman", it includes such poignant thoughts as:
1. Taking down bad guys with suaveness and style is the most important thing in life.
2. His dislike of Svalinn. Sure, he has muscles, but he's not the one the ladies should be swooning over.
3. He strives to be a good person, an awesome sharpshooter, a hero among men and god's gift to women.
100099: Bloody Mary has seen her fair share of inner darkness thanks to her ability to read hearts. Perhaps because of that, she despises self-righteous people and hypocrites, and lives her life as she desires. Believing that she has fully understood human nature, only one thing continues to baffle Bloody Mary: why is anyone still trying to lie to her?
100100: After Landwalker’s quick rise to fame upon establishing the unique Draken martial arts, the master vanished as suddenly as he appeared. When he was finally spotted in Narcia, he had become a martial arts tutor on the Rainbow Islands. Under Landwalker’s guidance, the young ones on the Rainbow Islands not only made great breakthroughs in their combat abilities, but also gained their own insights about the meaning of war and the truth of martial arts.
100101: Jumbear insists that eating honey all day, every day, is the reason for his strong physique. While most think this is naked gluttony, they all agree it's best to leave the bear be, content and carefree with his favorite food and ever-sticky fingers.
100102: Rambard has dedicated his life to singing tales of great heroes and their honorable deeds. Another story which he knows all too well is that of his own childhood: a belligerent child who encountered a saint he thought only existed in folklore. Through the saint's sage guidance, Rambard turned over a new leaf, relinquishing wicked weapons for an instrument to spread good. He has been a bard ever since, showing everyone that a horned and hoofed creature such as he can be noble and kind.
100103: One could say the Crystal Wraith was born to manipulate the powers of ice. His generosity towards all who seek him for power or sanctuary is a disguise for his true objective: to find the perfect body for his "realistic ice sculpture" project.
100104: The animal spirit of winter nights is proud but elusive. One may find its tracks wherever snow falls in the realm, but few have ever laid eyes on the creature.
100105: Beaten but unbowed, the Ice Lady regards her century-long exile to the land of permafrost as a test of endurance.
100106: Valiant Saintess is undoubtedly the busiest Hero on the sacred mountain. Besides helping others find purpose in life, she also takes interest in matchmaking heroes.
100107: Obtaining the runes' power is his proudest achievement, despite it costing him the sight in one eye. With runic power absorbed into his body, his former role as a sheltered, unknown advisor no longer satisfied him. Now a royal military strategist, he crafts tactics on the frontlines.
100108: After being horrifically burnt alive during battle, the Cinder Matron was resurrected. She endures as long as there is a trace of ashen fire on the scene.
100109: A mechanical being who has awoken from his ancient slumber beneath the desert. His presence proves a powerful empire once existed here. Alphamech's priority is to communicate with the local folk. While his might is undeniable, he is woefully unaccustomed to present-day languages.
100110: Light and Dark are two sides of the same coin: a bright flame also casts shadows. Yet few would embrace darkness as they would light, much to the Dark Mage's frustration. Determined to reverse this mindset, he helped uphold justice in the Lost Realm. After his actions were acknowledged by the Lost Realm denizens, he set forth to do the same in Narcia.
100111: At times, this extraordinary fighter wonders if his creator implanted impulsion traits in place of intelligence. His will to fight is so strong, he can even revive himself to continue the battle.
100112: A mysterious man who has traveled all over Narcia, hoping to prove himself the best warrior in the land. Although his opponents acknowledge his fighting ability, his eccentric behavior proved much more memorable.
100113: Miss Magic is the Moonshore Tavern's most beloved celebrity. She captures her audience's attention with bizarre and death-defying tricks. Even when these performances don't go as planned, they never fail to entertain.
100114: It seems the ancient dragon has re-appeared in Narcia, albeit in a different form. On Dynamica, an energy cannon takes the place of each wing, renouncing flight for something much more dangerous. Nowhere is safe from its energy blasts.
100115: According to Narcia's historical records, he was a prolific demon hunter... until he was corrupted by the ecstasy of slaughter, turning into a terrible demon himself. The last of his records vaguely describe him "searching for peace in a place of chaos".
100116: Born from the first sparks of the Lawful Summit's energy crystal, he was gifted the speed of lightning. His hobbies include climbing and practicing parkour on the peaks of the Lawful Summit. He also likes to find unique uses for lightning, as one can tell from his signature hairstyle.
100118: Like the soft rippling of water, the Water Priestess is gentle and kind. She faithfully directs the flow of rivers and streams, and uses the power of water to soothe and comfort the injured. In the face of incorrigible evil, she unleashes punishment with waves of terror.
100119: FI-0059 debugging complete! The Mad Inventor has successfully invented thousands of weapons, and has never failed. As for what exactly happens during the process, surely you can tell by his name.
100120: The punisher from Lawful Summit, stern without any hint of a smile. Anyone who goes against the will of the ancestors will have to endure his punishments without complaint.
100121:
Do not attempt to get near Massacre!
Avoid his gaze as much as possible!
Don't even think about talking to him!
- Advice from an explorer who escaped
100122: A young man who often wears a solemn expression. At rare times, he breaks into a smile when running and climbing with his best friend, Young Spark.
100123: A female pharoah whose life and reign were cut short during a period of brutal political struggle. She was mummified and sealed away in a sarcophagus, only to return from the dead seeking immortality and domination.
100124:
"Never destroy the energy crystal, nor use it for evil." 
As the guardian of the energy crystal, Colossus gently reminds anyone attempting to get close. His trademark smile makes people feel at ease. Ever since cracks formed on the crystal, a veneer of danger lies beneath his unchanging smile.
100125: He weaves the legends of tragic heroes from the Cliff of Chaos into melancholic tunes. Could these heroes be of his making?
100127: A princess from a fallen kingdom who has lost herself in chaos. For ages, she has wandered without knowing her destination, searching for signs of her long-lost people in everyone she encounters.
100128: Although Genteel Droid impresses everyone with his humble and elegant demeanor, he doesn't think himself worthy to be called a gentleman. Believing he lacks a pocket watch, he examines every gear needed to create one. He has become increasingly anxious because he hasn't found a suitable center wheel for his pocket watch.
100129: Her body is controlled by a precise mechanical core. Her every move befits a noble lady, ever elegant and perfect. When asked if this modification is what she wanted, she always answers with a demure but affirmative nod. Nobody knows for sure if this response is hers or the mechanical core's.
100130:
"The guilty will be punished while the innocent will walk free."
When faced with the scythe-wielding Inquisitess and the dutiful Axe Punisher, the only words you want to hear are, "Not guilty".
100131: Once covered with parasitic thorns and vines that drained its body of nutrients, the wild dragon's body overcame the infection by absorbing the aggressive parasites into its bloodstream. Its sanguine wings, flowing with parasite-ridden blood, are the dragon's source of pain and power.
100132: One of the few beings capable of harnessing the powers of the stars. The might of the cosmos can be felt with every blow.
100133: An evil spirit who wanders under the cover of darkness. Just the mere mention of her name will send a chill down one's spine.
100134: As overseer of the Cloister of Learning, the Despotic Maestro is happy to carry the burden of responsibility. He enjoys performing his piece, "Sonata of the Learned", in his spare time. During battles, he often utters the words, "listen to my command", and proceeds to conduct an uplifting score. His underlings are always stressed by his oppressive attitude, which is present even after a flawless musical or battle performance.
100135: An ordinary monster created from rock fragments and black soil that grew tentacles from the corrupting influence of deep-sea merfolk. In contrast to its terrifying appearance, it is actually very timid. The slightest hint of danger triggers its excessive self-defense behavior.
100136: They may not look it, but this prankster cat spirit is the Cloister of Learning's oldest resident. While the younger cat spirits lament that the Catty Spirit's tricks are boring and old-fashioned, they remain unfazed, knowing they are still effective.
100137: While traveling in the Simmering Ruins, he discovered a connection between the Annihilators and the monsters that originated here. He's stayed alone in the darkness since to slay the forces of evil. Slayer of Evil, Wanderer of Justice, The Glimmering Hope... These are some of the monikers he thought of for himself as he dreamed of being immortalized in songs.
100138: She is the last descendant of her clan and has completely erased her past. With her ninja blade as her sole companion, she wandered the realm for many years until she arrived at the Cloister of Learning. There, when a bright light illuminated her face, she knew her new life had begun...
100139: Serratica no longer remembers its home and clan. Its last memory as a young dragon is of playing on the plains when it was swept away by a vortex, its flesh cut by countless blades.
100140: The Cloister of Learning formed an army to drive back the invading Annihilators. Drunken Simian, a high-ranking general, has greatly weakened the Annihilators' morale after leading his forces to countless victories. He explains one must have a clear mind to excel at command and combat. Shaking the gourd that's always in his hand, he adds it's the wine that provides him clarity.
100141: Death awaits anyone who tries to leave the Annihilator army, but somehow he managed to escape with his life. Still, he considers himself a person who once died, having carved his own tombstone to serve as a constant reminder of his sinful past. He now resolves to crush the Annihilators and their evil deeds, even if it means destroying souls as tortured his own.
100142: The Cloister of Learning has amassed its own army to defend against the Annihilators. This man leads the vanguard with unshakable virtue and fortitude. No matter how formidable his enemies seem, he charges fearlessly to break their formation.
100143: A member of the Annihilator army stationed in the Simmering Ruins to draft more monsters into the legion. But instead of following her orders, she decided to collect the creatures in her magical scroll for her own cause, in an act of rebellion against her own servitude.
100144: Despite being a winged one, Stormwing has lived in the Cloister of Learning since she was a teenager. In that age of rebellious tendencies, she ran away from her clan to escape what she saw as oppression. Now as an adult reflecting on her actions, she realized the true reasons for her running away: she was weak and feared taking on the responsibilities expected of her. As the threat of the Annihilator legion inches closer to her homeland, she can no longer stay away. Armed with storm-controlling skills she learned in the Cloister of Learning, she is ready to assume her rightful role as a winged guardian.
100145: The Underworld Judge decides the fate of every new life in the Simmering Ruins. He either leaves them alone and lets them grow into terrifying monsters, or mummifies them and uses them as his tools. No one knew the mighty and fearsome judge was once a little snake slithering away at the Pharaoh's feet.
100146:
"Be careful, these are fragile."
Crystella's heart fills with worry whenever she sees an enemy.
100147: Tundrahoof was captured by the Annihilators when he was out delivering gifts one day. His captors took him to the Simmering Ruins, where he was forced to endure painful body modifications that turned him into a living weapon. Sometimes he still remembers how he used to pull a sleigh and deliver presents to children many winter nights ago, but the warm nostalgia of those happy times has been replaced by biting cold. Now that his body is a fighting machine, he hopes to present children with the greatest gift of all: peace, while making sure not to get captured by the Annihilators again, of course.
100148: Legends of old claim he forged the first sword in all of Narcia and possesses an affinity with every sword in the land. Rumor or no, the Sword Sage is Narcia's most knowledgeable figure on swords and sword techniques, living up to his name in every way.
100149: A fire elemental created by the Annihilators, the Flame Darklord was meant to serve the legion as a powerful warrior. But he proved too chaotic to control. Now he hovers around the Omniscient Altar all day, where he still causes trouble for the Annihilators.
100150: One can summon a beautiful fairy by applying a love spell on a carefully selected vine rose. In the Hall of Wisdom, a master sorcerer followed this spell in hopes of creating the love of his life. Unfortunately for him, the Flower Fae he created turned out fiercely independent.
100151: In the past, many knights and swordsmen volunteered to disguise themselves as evil creatures to infiltrate and spy on the enemy camps. They become unnamed ghosts, concealing every bit of their honor to blend themselves into the darkness. Only when the war ends can they finally return to the light and reclaim their identities.
100152: A wriggling caterpillar once believed with all her heart she would transform into something greater. After breaking out of her cocoon, she had indeed morphed into a butterfly spirit. With her belief in transformation stronger than ever, she is committed to self-improvement, not just for herself but for others as well.
100153: A puppet of the Annihilators, Void Knight was created in the Simmering Ruins. When Void Knight started working for the Hex Painter, he was sent to guard the Omniscient Altar. Under his master's commands, he sometimes helps Lords fight the Annihilators. As a puppet supposedly loyal to the Annihilators, he had his doubts. But he is more devoted to his current master, so he follows the Hex Painter's orders without question.
100154: Jewellee is one of the most famous jewel collectors on the continent. But she doesn't collect the precious jewels to wear or decorate her home. She crafts them into bombs, so she can show her allies and enemies the most brilliant explosions on the battlefield.
100155: The divine guardian dragon of the Hall of Wisdom, a creature born from wisdom and sunlight. For a long time, Celestica guarded the Hall of Wisdom and bestowed knowledge and wisdom on those recognized by the Hall. To the people, they are intelligent, gentle, radiate sunshine, and give hope, so some people forget that their sharp roar can cause enemies to lose sanity and enter a state of confusion. In the worst cases, they can cause enemies to fight among themselves and bring doom!
100156:
"Oww!"
This timid knight of the Annihilators is always hiding beneath his armor and speaking unreliably. His clumsiness and foolishness has often caused the failure of some the Annihilators' operations. Perhaps some have noticed, but this knight who's always dragging the Annihilators down is actually fighting them in his own unique way. Maybe someday, people will chant his name and declare him a true knight!
100157: A famous book about dragons compiled by the Dragon Scholar. Many recognize his most iconic symbol - a giant horn engraved with a dragon emblem, but few know about his narrow brush with death in the mountains, where he traveled in order to master knowledge about dragons and forge a friendship with them.
100158: This strange baron born from the shadows swirling around the Omniscient Altar may not know where they came from, but he knows how to control them. They turn into eerie Shadow Spirits in his hands, giving enemies a devastating bite or shrouding the hearts of bystanders in lingering gloom.
100159: The Spider Queen was displeased when the Annihilators came to her home to build the Omniscient Altar, even if it meant plenty more prey to hunt with her webs. The smoke and dust from the construction made her blood boil. Those who dare dirty the queen's dress will never be forgiven!
100160: It is believed the Lightchaser is chosen by the light because of he has so much in common with light. This shows in the way he fights—flashy, uninhibited, proud, and zealous, just like the sun burning brightly in the sky, piercing through the darkness of the night.
100161: His body is formed by pieces of the Omniscient Altar that collapsed before it was completed. An all-seeing eye is attached to his forehead, while others are collected in his lantern. Evil Eye's assets allow him to peruse the Annihilators' sins and the darkest secrets of some of Narcia's heroes. While he derives pleasure in exploring the evil in others, he is unaware of his own creeping descent into the abyss of sin.
100162: A pious young lady who worships the moon. In its presence, she learned skills shaped like the arc of the moon. Having been blessed by the moon, she gained the power of light and was forged into a strong individual.
100163: It was once a slave, forced to work at the Omniscient Altar all year round. Every day, it hid its rage beneath its docile appearance. When the Omniscient Altar collapsed, the energy meant to activate the Omniscient Eye engulfed the hapless creature who was working at the scene. That was the moment it broke free from its enslavement, and a beast called the Tusked Menace was unleashed into Narcia.
100164: After war broke out, the free denizens of Narcia decided to build the Spiritual Academy. When the time came to choose its dean, everyone agreed Mystrix was only individual upstanding, knowledgeable, and well-connected enough for the role. Already a pioneer in spiritual practices, Mystrix easily filled the top position in the Academy.
100165: A heroic fighter of the ocean who is often praised and admired by his people. He surfaces from the ocean and steps onto the darkened coast, wanting to make a name for himself in this war-stricken land!
100166: As the merfolk ravaged the shore she called home, the clean coast turned filthy, and her appearance grew dark and sinister. But her heart remained untainted. She kept her pure character, standing strong alone between the violent wind and the muddy shore.
100167: On the day the Spiritual Academy first opened for lessons, a seed left in the academy's garden sprouted. Under the care of the school, the seed blossomed, bore fruit, and eventually took on a human form. It achieved great improvements in spiritual skill in just a few years. Just like the glow of the fruit she holds, her growth signifies life and miracles.
100168: While many a hero in Narcia can see spirits, the Soul Seeker's ability to recognize the good spirits from their evil counterparts is rare. He has since honed this childhood gift at the Spiritual Academy. In this time of war, he has made it his mission to extricate innocent souls from suffering and banish the evil ones into oblivion.
100169: He believes that everything in this world is attributed to a sleeping monster sealed in the depths of the sea. He spreads the word of ancient beast throughout the continent, convinced that all in this land will fall under the monster's dominion when it awakes. And when that day comes, he will stand by its side as its most devout and fanatical follower.
100170: Born with exceptional spirituality, she was guided by her family to become an outstanding figure in the field of spiritual practice at a very young age. After the construction of the Spiritual Academy, she went there to explore the secrets of spiritual practice more deeply, which led to her increasingly advanced cultivation and mental clarity. Through long-term practice, she has gained eternal enlightenment for both her body and soul, and has become an eternal existence in the realm of higher spirituality.
100171: He was one of the first warriors to charge in the front lines when war first broke out. And when Mystrix established the Spiritual Academy, he immediately stepped forward to take on the role of its defender, staunchly following his principle of going wherever he was needed. His presence deters anyone from disrupting the order of daily life in the Spiritual Academy.
100172:
It was once a peaceful dragon that lived by the shore and enjoyed the warm coastal breezes that caressed its scales. But everything changed one evening when a strange gloomy wind blew and an evil force rose from the sea. A strange missionary began to spread ideas of insanity on shore, corrupting many coastal creatures and even the massive dragon. After losing control of itself, the dragon destroyed everything on the coast.
The body of this dragon is now a grotesque mass of scale-less skin and exposed bones, seemingly held together by the stake protruding from its chest. In the short periods when it regains its sanity, the creature is filled with regret and despair.
However the creature is, after all, a dragon - the most magnificent of creatures in all of Narcia. As long as a sliver of sanity remains within it, the dragon will not sink forever into the nightmare.
100173: On the eastern coast of Narcia, Melody stands atop a towering reef, playing the violin day and night. The melodious sound of the strings echoes through the mountains and the roaring tides. The vibrant sound of her violin inspires Heroes to tighten their grip on their weapons and fight on for justice with a resounding battle cry. As long as Melody plays, Narcia's glory will shine forever.
100174: Too many experiences and memories, complicated and long... the old man felt encumbered by them. With the help of scholars at the Spiritual Academy, he has turned the past into smoke and stored it in a bottle that he carries with him. When the war ends, he will continue on his lifelong journey towards oblivion, but this time, he'll remember to forget whatever he sees and hears along the way.
100175: The most devoted follower of the heinous deep sea religion has been completely transformed by the potent evil of the watery depths. So pleased is she with her present self that she has utterly forgotten her past.
100176: He's aware that a candle that has gained consciousness will still be a candle when it dies. But before that happens, he intends to fully explore his possibilities while he's alive. As the Spiritual Academy's night watchman, a keeper of the night's secrets, and a source of hope for desperate folk, he lights up the lives of the bleak like... a candle!
100177: With this ghostly member of the merfolk watching you when you're out at sea, you don't have to be afraid of drowning. Upon your death, he'll turn you into a puppet, rendering your body under his absolute control and your soul forever tormented. At least you can still stand and walk around, right?
100178: Merfolk from the depths of the sea sought to resurrect their greatest deity by capturing beings along the coastline and attempting to transform them into vessels for the divine consciousness. This enigmatic hero, neither human nor ghost, trapped within the confines of their own eternal sorrow, is just a small fragment of that dark chapter in history.
100179:
The wind and snow answer her call, and the majestic eagle willingly obeys her command.
Born in times of war, she has already experienced sorrow and traversed through darkness despite her young age.
Yet, her eyes always radiate a resolute determination, as clear and unyielding as ice.
100181:
A graceful figure hidden behind the reef, the mermaid's song shattered in the sea breeze.
- What an interesting legend, unrelated to her.
Who cares about petrifying lost travelers? Who cares about punishing greedy sailors?
- What a strange hobby. It deserves neither a single smile nor mockery from her.
117901: A shield imbued by royal mages. Only the strongest paladins in the land can lift it.
117902: Made from an unknown material in the Lost Realm, it hypnotizes unwary travelers to siphon their souls.
117903: Ninjas must abandon any shred of humanity for their line of work. Wearing a mask helps them avoid recognition, and embody the devil within them.
117904: This slithering vine is ever-thirsty for blood, and eager to sink its thorns into living flesh.
117905: The axe is favored among many races for adventuring and dragon-hunting. None are superior to the dwarves in wielding this versatile weapon.
117906: Made from the branches of an ancient tree, this staff grants vitality to all who seek its protection.
117907: A legendary weapon that summons lightning. Requires immortal strength to wield.
117908: While most pumpkins expect to end up eaten, this one was destined to be a vessel for restless souls.
117909: A totem dedicated to the Earth Mother. Grants the carrier great strength in the battlefield.
117910: The Reaper's weapon is as symbolic as it is deadly. A single slash will send its victim to the underworld.
117911: A combination of rare minerals makes Atlanticore's body virtually impervious.
117912: This scarf gained special powers when Santa left it under a magical mistletoe.
117913: A delicate bow lovingly smelted by gods. It fires arrows that fill one with desire.
117914: A brilliant gem inscribed with hieroglyphics. It is said to grant everlasting life, but at what cost...?
117915: The red scales of a fire-breathing dragon, the last of its kind.
117916: Death is a release from the ongoing nightmare of war.
117917: It appears well-kept despite having existed for centuries, much like its owner.
117918: A blade that fused with a meteor and the souls of those who perished from its impact.
117919: The sight of its jagged edge sends shivers down its enemies' spines.
117920: Bringing merriment to the battlefield since 1773.
117921: Pixie's wings turned petal-like when she learned to control her blossoming powers.
117922: A bow fashioned from the teeth of sea monsters. The Siren draws power from the ocean whenever she uses it.
117923: An evil object that constantly twists and writhes. Only an unearthly being could hold it.
117924: A book containing the greatest spells ever written.
117925: An orb of pure life essence. Grants vigor to creatures around it.
117926: Revered for its power and luster, the jewel is passed down through generations of winged guardians who protect it with their lives.
117927: A bone sword of unspeakable power. Once wielded, its dark energy causes enemies to tremble uncontrollably.
117928: This eyepatch was supposedly buried with cursed treasure. It is said to grant its wearer boundless energy.
117929: Blood seems to swirl within the scarlet gem that granted life to a gargoyle.
117930: The sound of its bell seems to have a tranquilizing effect, leaving one's legs to feel heavy.
117931: An ornament that freezes flesh. Grants frost breath to its wearer.
117932: Exquisitely crafted with pink gemstones, each wave of this wand calms frayed minds and mends resolve.
117933: Restless souls swirl around the crown, jealously protecting it.
117934: Shamans cast spells on necklaces made of animal parts to retain the creature's spirit. This allows the wearer to summon the animal as a familiar.
117935: Harnesses and amplifies the power of lightning. A force to be reckoned with in the battlefield.
117936: A pair of shoulder guards possessed by an evil soul.
117937: This axe has taken so many lives that it can sense a creature's weak spot. All it takes is one killing blow!
117938: While pleasing to the eye, this harp is now an instrument of horror that no longer plays beautiful melodies.
117939: Demogorgon's unusual horns crackle with energy, and unleash an electrical storm when fully charged.
117940: A wand created from ingredients that only witches can think of.
117941: An undead creature of charred bone. Its red eyes could send one over the edge of madness.
117942: A magical bell that can summon a thousand blizzards.
117943: Once a glorious lance, its holy light now fluctuates between corrupting darkness.
117944: Heartbreaker's handy patent-pending cannon, complete with blast protection and heart-shaped stickers.
117945: When the world sinks into chaos, the Divine Axe will shatter the land to begin life anew.
117946:
Blade sweeps in a flash.
The battleground falls silent.
Loneliness prevails.
117947: This pistol's humble aesthetic hides its highly advanced components. Ingeniously designed to energize its bullets and wielder.
117948: A huge hammer that is smelted with rare metals. Lingering energy hints at its alchemical origin.
117949: Once dismissed as junk, this curious mechanical orb absorbs energy from the air to power up a dormant machine...
117953: Eerie whispers emanate from these bones. At first, this claw seems harmless to the touch, but it rises to flesh-searing temperatures without warning.
117954: Once a tribe's holy artifact, this staff now holds malevolent power. Wait...Did that bird just move?!
117955: A painful restraint that discharges powerful electric shocks.
117956: Holy light illuminates the battlefield, brightening even the darkest of hearts.
117957: Once a malevolent tree of power, now a reusable Christmas decoration.
117958: A compilation of arcane lore penned by the greatest warlock ever known. Greatly sought after by mages and collectors.

101025:
1. The top 3,000 Guilds with the highest Might may participate in Fortress Feud.
2. Registration opens on the 1st and 3rd Saturday of every month at 09:00 (server time). 3 Battlefields will open for registration during every Fortress Feud event. Guilds may only register for 1 Battlefield per event. Battlefields may accept up to 800 registered Guilds.
3. The event will end once a Guild reaches the required Capture Points to win or 30 minutes have passed, whichever comes first.
4. Capture Points are the main criterion for winning the event. Guilds must capture as many Outposts, Strongholds, and Fortresses as they can to obtain Capture Points. The first Guild to reach 30,000 Capture Points wins.
5. If no Guild in a division reaches 30,000 Capture Points by the end of the event, the Guilds will be ranked according to Capture Points obtained.
6. If two or more Guilds in a division reach 30,000 Capture Points, their total Battle Points will determine their division ranking.
7. When attacking an enemy Outpost, Stronghold, or Fortress, you must eliminate all enemy teams within until it becomes Unoccupied before you can capture it.
8. You need to make sure there is at least one team in the stronghold during the occupation period. The occupation will fail otherwise.
9. Make sure to place at least one friendly team to defend an Outpost, Stronghold, or Fortress. Otherwise, it will become Unoccupied.
10. Players can use Revive Stones to revive their Heroes killed in battle.
11. Non-evolved Heroes below Lv 100 cannot participate in battles.
101026:
1. Players who participate in Fortress Feud will receive rewards according to their Guild's and individual performance.
2. Guilds will be rewarded according to their ranking in their division. The higher the ranking, the greater the reward.
3. Solo rewards will be given according to each player's Battle Points ranking in their division. The higher the ranking, the greater the reward.
4. You must participate in the event to obtain the event rewards. Rewards will be sent to your mailbox after the event ends.

1. Participate in various activities to earn Contribution. 
2. Contribute to your Guild's total to win Guild Chests. Rarer Guild Chests will require more Contribution. 
3. Each player can only earn up to 200 Contribution daily (resets at 0:00). 
4. Contribution is tallied at 23:55 every Sunday to 0:00 the next day. During this time, Contribution remains unchanged. 
5. How to earn Contribution: 
Earn 3 Contribution each time you sign in to your Guild, obtain Pet Eggs, or participate in Dungeons, Raids, the Arena, Expeditions, the Lost Battlefield, Hero Trials, Team Dungeons, Here Be Monsters, or Team Here Be Monsters. 
Earn 10 Contribution each time you participate in Blitz Gauntlet, or Squad Showdown, up to a maximum of 30 Contribution. 
Earn 20 Contribution for every Guild event you participate in. For Narcia: War Era, you can get up to a maximum of 30 Contribution. 
Earn 1 Contribution for every Stamina used in the Lost Realm. 
Earn 1 Contribution for every Gem used.

115111:
1. The Guild Leader and Vice-Leader can tap the button on the right of each Guild member in the Member interface to enter member management mode. In this mode, they can promote, demote, or expel members.
2. The Guild Leader and Vice-Leader can tap "Approve" to manage Guild membership applications.
3. If the Guild Leader has not logged in to the game for more than 7 days, the Guild can impeach the Guild Leader. Once the Guild Leader is impeached, the voting for a new Guild Leader will begin, and will last for 24 hours. When the voting ends, the member with the highest votes will become the Guild Leader. If the existing Guild Leader logs in to the game during this period, the voting will still continue.
4. If multiple members receive the same number of votes, the member who donated the most Shards will become the Guild Leader.
5. The Guild Leader cannot disband the Guild until all members have left.
6. To prevent misuse of the function, only 10 members can be expelled from the Guild in a day.
7. The Guild cannot participate in Guild Wars if its Guild Leader has not logged in for the past 30 days.
8. The Guild will be disbanded if its Guild Leader has not logged in for the past 60 days.

1. Each Squad Showdown season lasts 7 days, followed by an off-season of 7 days before the next season starts.
2. During a season, you can participate daily at 01:00-23:00 server time. You have 3 challenge attempts per day.
3. Every season features different Factions. Only the Heroes from the featured Factions may participate.
4. When a battle only has 1 minute left, DMG received by each unit is increased by 200%, and will continue to increase once every 10s until the battle ends.
5. Earn 1 Star whenever you win a match. Lose 1 Star whenever you lose a match. No Stars are earned or lost if your match ends in a draw.
6. When you have maxed the Stars in your current Tier, winning the next match will send you to the next Tier.
7. Tier order: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Invincible.

123021:
Members of the Undead Legion gathered on the Silent Hills, unperturbed by the bitter cold and atmosphere of despair.
Grimfiend waited silently against a collapsed stone pillar while Skeletica circled the skies above, its enormous wings stirring the air. Vlad Dracula and Death Knight soon appeared before them. Brushing off his uncertainty, Werewolf too joined this cast of horrors. 
With a gesture from the leader, Revenant, they all embarked for the Royal Capital.
123022:
The silent mountains were a stark contrast to what Revenant remembered of this place. A thousand years might have passed, but the memories of his empire's rise remained fresh in his mind.
The invasion of the Royal Capital may have failed, but Revenant did not care. After all, his true objective had been the humans he had captured. He would have his army of thralls.
123023:
The prisoners were filled with dread when they realized they were the real reason the battle for the Royal Capital had been fought. Just as Death Knight was about to cut them down, his blade was blocked by a dark figure. 
"Run! I can't hold him off forever!" Werewolf growled. "Perhaps there's a part of me that's still Human... " he thought. 
The prisoners escaped through a ridge, looking back only when it was safe. They saw the figure of Werewolf fighting off the Legion with a wolf's tenacity and a Human's faith.
123024: " Hey, furball! Do you know the secret behind the Royal Capital's lavishness? Well, the answer is War! While Valentina and Paladin protected the capital with Warlock's help, countless people living outside the palace walls were abandoned, left to fend for themselves against the Undead Legion. The walls couldn't block the desperate pleas and screams of swift deaths, however. Hey, do you mind moving that tree of yours? You're interrupting my story."
123026: " I witnessed the battle first-hand, and have many more tales about that day. But let's leave them for another time. You're the first listener I've had in ten years, and you turned out to be a pretty good one. Alright, I'm going to take a nap before getting back to my people-watching duty. There aren't too many things a busted statue can do, you know. "
123027: Many have heard legends of a realm filled with dangerous monsters and valuable Crystals. However, few people have actually found this Lost Realm, and fewer still have traveled to it.
123028: It wasn't always this way, however. The denizens of the Lost Realm once participated in our war of good versus evil. But as the war dragged on, Espirita, warden of the Lost Realm, decided it was best for the Lost Realm to withdraw. She led the spirits home, and hid the Lost Realm in a pocket universe, hoping to keep her flock safe.
123029: The Lost Realm would have remained hidden, if not for Demogorgon's rampage. Thunder God chanced upon it when he tracked Demogorgon from the edges of the world. He sent his follower, Lady Leo, to defend the Lost Realm from Demogorgon. There, she fought alongside many of the realm's denizens. Thanks to Lady Leo's valor, the Lost Realm would return the favor, in one way or another.
123030: The pursuit of power can be a grotesque affair. Immortep, the ex-ruler of this once grand empire, was obsessed with immortality. He collected artifacts from far and wide, and eventually stumbled upon several ancient creatures sealed beneath the earth. The creatures promised to grant him the eternal youth he sought... for a price: the blood of his people.
123031: After feasting on the souls of so many, the creatures refused to honor their promise, and began breaking their seals. However, Immortep was cautious, and had prepared a trap beforehand. He managed to keep Anubis sealed, and then periodically drained Anubis' life force, thus attaining "immortality". This angered Grizzly Reaper, who set out on a quest to claim Immortep's soul.
123032: The ruins you see are all that is left from that tale. Although many years have passed, the ruins are still frequented by treasure hunters or those seeking the secrets of immortality. What most people don't know, is that the greatest treasures are still protected by Immortep and Anubis.
123033: For centuries, the Ancient Forest sheltered its inhabitants from the wars that ravaged the realm. But that changed when the winged ones of old joined forces with other creatures to slay a dragon. In their obsession, the winged ones drained the Forest's protective life force to forge a single gem. The damage was irreparable, and led to the winged ones' exile from the Forest.
123034: Currently, the Forest's life force is scarce, possessed only by a handful who have proven their devotion. But that hasn't deterred scores of mercenaries, driven by their struggle for power, from searching for it. They have brazenly trampled through the Ancient Forest and captured its denizens, including Druid and Dryad. In the face of such malice, the forest could no longer stay passive...
123035: The gentle creatures of the forest needed a great deal of help to defend themselves. Eager to mend ties, descendants of the disgraced winged ones approached to lend their strength. Eventually, a treaty was signed: heroes including Gunslinger and elite winged warriors would protect the forest covertly. However, when Pixie - a direct descendant of the winged ones - flew into the forest, she encountered immediate hostility. Would the alliance break apart from within?
123036: The founder of Moonshore Tavern was nothing short of legendary. No one was ever turned away when he was in charge. He never took sides, and instead offered precious serenity to a divided realm. One could say that there was no place more harmonious than this humble tavern. The founder's kindness and quiet wisdom attracted many to his shelter, which pleased him. Surely his ideals - justice and honor - would live on in the land's future heroes...
123037: Alas, things are different these days. The tavern could be described as dangerous, yet charming - much like its current barkeep, Candy Kane. Reverence for Honor and Justice have waned in favor of raw might. But there is hope yet for a revelation against the backdrop of escalating war.
123038: While a motley crew led by Executioner, Champion, and Dread Drake aided the needy on the battlegrounds, a mysterious being appeared before the Moonshore Tavern. It was Cirrina, Queen of the Abyss, seeking the one who had dared to disturb her charge. Little did she expect the perpetrator, Aries, to provide a solid explanation. Moved by Aries' conviction to defend humanity, Cirrina agreed to fight alongside him against the Silent Hills.
123039: The epic tale of Narcia speaks of how the immortals imprisoned evil beasts, subdued giant dragons, and exterminated nefarious spirits to cleanse the land. During these battles, they were deeply wounded and took refuge on the Celestial Peak. And when disaster struck once again, the immortals failed to respond to our prayers, as they had been afflicted by internal strife for years without our knowledge...
123040: The dark truth of the Celestial Peak stands in stark contrast to its glorious past. Those in power persecute those different from them: they deceive the dragons, and turn defeated enemies into restless spirits while placing themselves upon pedestals to be worshipped. Cupid, Angel, and most of the newer gods have no knowledge of the past, and know nothing of the truth. But Thunder God knows, and instigated a revolt against the ones in power. But he was betrayed by Storm Eater, defeated, and exiled.
123041: With help from the Lost Realm, the exiled Thunder God eventually returned to the land of the gods. In the past, he wanted to punish the tyrants, but had no courage to expose their evil deeds. But now, he is determined to reveal the evil hidden within the Celestial Peak, and let all on Narcia judge the culprits. Upon hearing the news, the battle goddess Athene decided to join the Thunder God. Michael, who developed his own suspicions after his battles in the Silent Hills, started to question himself and the rest of the Celestial Peak. Only when all the wrongs have been righted on Narcia will the immortals become true gods of the land.
123042: Let us recount how the Voodoo Village "died". The tribe and their mysterious practices were never accepted by the neighboring kingdom. The village's growth only deepened the suspicion and fear towards them. On that fateful day, they never expected the kingdom would launch a full-scale attack to exterminate the "heathens". As fellow tribe members perished around her, Medusa desperately turned to the forbidden arts, chanting a terrible curse to slay her enemies, even at the risk of her own life.
123043: While the horrible curse spared Medusa's life, it transformed the beauty into a petrifying creature and granted her the power to collect the souls of her perished kin. Medusa searched for and gathered living members who were wandering the realm, convincing them to return and restore their homeland. The newly-reformed village soon called for assistance far and wide, offering solace and knowledge to anyone willing to help in its rebuilding.
123044: Alas, the village's peaceful and amiable appearance was hiding a sinister plot. Serpent Queen, who braved the journey from the Barren Sands to pursue knowledge, discovered the scheme by accident. Realizing that the villagers were actually sacrificing those lured by their proposition, Serpent Queen alerted other samaritans and disrupted many evil ploys. Could the village's destiny be changed by this outsider?
123045: The Burning Ravine was not always a fiery pit. It was once a magnificent canyon that was also a backdrop for some enticing rumors... of dragons. Some believed that these beasts would grant them draconic powers if they proved their worth in battle, or that only the wisest minds would gain their friendship. Other stories describe hoards of dragons' treasure amassed within the cliffs. The rumors persisted among Narcia's denizens, even though no one had ever proven the dragons' existence...
123046: One day, the fearsome dragon Moltanica appeared in the sky, and set everything in its path ablaze with its fire breath as it soared over the canyon. It has been known as the Burning Ravine ever since. Many now journey into the sweltering land, hoping to catch a glimpse of the creature beyond the flame and the fire.
123047: Unbeknownst to Narcia, the disturbances above ground had revealed a creature of another kind. Moltanica discovered an awakened Destroyer, and released its bonds in exchange for an alliance. Together, they assembled an army in their scorching territory. Moltanica's eyes flared as it relished the thought of avenging its kin... Arctica would burn for slaying them. Lavanica, learning of the scheme, seeks allies of its own to stop the potential war between dragons.
123048: It started as a small arena in a narrow valley. Asura founded it to uphold proper dueling rules as he was passionate about fair duels. The arena drew many combat enthusiasts, and it evolved into a fully-fledged underground city called Subterrania, with many arenas catering to myriad fascinating combat and magic duels.
123049: As more heroes headed into Subterrania to seek opponents, the city became a foreboding place. After a few chaotic riots, the Assassin's Alliance was born. It was created by Asura himself, and took the role of enforcing law and order in the city. Anyone who disrupted the peace was mercilessly hunted down and killed. The city became known for its draconian laws.
123050: When war broke out in Narcia, the militant Subterrania was one of the few places untouched by it. As the atrocities continued topside, however, heroes began questioning their beliefs and wondered if it was right for them to refrain from taking part in the war. When Asura discovered that the stolen Blood Gem had been taken to the Royal Capital, he abandoned the city he had founded, gathered an army, and headed off to the capital to try to put an end to the war...
123051: The Frozen Wilds lie along the path to the Celestial Peak, a frigid land where cold winds howl and stalagmites like fangs line the ground. It is known to house all manners of exiles, including students who broke the laws of magic, and vessels that housed awakened souls. These exiles became prisoners of this icy cage, with no choice but to wait for the day the land claimed their lives.
123052: Yet not all of the exiles lost their lives to the Frozen Wilds. To further her research, Ma Hatma saved some of these exiles and taught them to survive in the Frozen Wilds. They formed an organization devoted to studying ice magic, and would willingly become one with the freezing ice.
123053: The actions of these exiles woke Arctica, the dragon of the wilds. But the exiles were fearless. Led by Ma Hatma, the exiles challenged the dragon time and again. The battles with the mighty dragon brought them euphoria, and blinded them from the true danger: Ma Hatma, who would sacrifice them at any moment for her research. And Arctica, who hid its true powers...
123054: Located in the midst of Narcia's deep ocean, the Rainbow Islands are a tropical paradise blessed with warm sunshine and perennial rainbows. Legend has it that the first inhabitants came from a faraway land fraught with danger and conflict. Thankfully, their difficult journey paid off. Having found their ideal environment, these pioneers eagerly set root and flourished on the islands' tranquil shores.
123055: For the most part, the inhabitants today still enjoy a carefree lifestyle - one that their ancestors would surely approve of. The islands had been getting more visitors lately, thanks to a rumor spreading across the mainland. It tells of a secular tribe with mysterious powers hiding on the islands. Many came to explore, but none could prove the authenticity of the rumor. As the fuss started to die down, some explorers chose to stay on the islands, not to pursue anything in particular, but to live out their lives in peace.
123056: The war that broke out in Narcia did not affect the islanders' lives one bit. No, their wake-up call would strike closer to home. One day, the sea formed massive waves strong enough to toss Siren out of her underwater home and onto the shore. The islanders soon discovered that there was another war raging in the sea beneath them. They could not afford to ignore the imminent conflict. For the first time, the inhabitants of Rainbow Island readied themselves to defend their home and the neighboring merfolk.
123057: Once upon a time, a scattering of indigenous tribes were the sole inhabitants of Narcia's central mountains. That quickly changed when a hostile clan of winged invaders conquered them in one fell swoop. The winged ones controlled a magnificent kingdom that stretched almost the entire mountain range. Despite their early transgressions towards the natives, every ruler of the winged clan openly shared their knowledge and imparted their skills. This promising diplomacy did not save the short-lived dynasty, however.
123058: Beneath the glorious, infallible appearance of their dominion, each ruler of the winged clan bore a heavy burden - redemption. Before they had built their empire, this proud race had been banished from the Ancient Forest. Struggling to cope with their shame, they still hope to regain the Forest's goodwill by aiding others in what they do best. But hatred, anger, and other negative feelings - the same that gave rise to the Bogeyman - were never fully contained within.
123059: When the war over Narcia spread and threatened the Ancient Forest, Harpy Queen reached out to help despite protests from those still bitter over their banishment. Fortunately for the winged ones, their queen's pure act of kindness would sprout something that they had long sought: a path that would lead them to true glory.
