123100: The Lawful Summit is bathed in the light of the blazing sun; a place light has never abandoned. Records show even the earliest dwellers were amazed by the phenomenon of eternal daylight, believing it to be a gift from the Creator. Fearing any slight misstep would invoke the night or heavenly punishment, they established strict laws that generations of their descendants have strictly followed: do not wage war and do not entertain evil thoughts. But the Lawful Summit's peace was broken when a crack formed on its energy crystal. Had someone broken the rules...?
123101: The rule-abiding elders never expected the cracks in the energy crystal to be sabotage. The descendants, led by Young Spark, are weary of the strict laws on Lawful Summit. They couldn't sit idly by while war raged on in Narcia, and were desperate to reveal the power of the energy crystal. The way they saw it, a land trapped forever in daytime is not a sign of the Creator's blessing, but a cruel punishment.
123102: As the battle intensified in Narcia, so did the conflict between the older and younger generations on Lawful Summit. In the end, the old-timers conceded, choosing a trustworthy Hero to heed Athene's call, joining the war against the Annihilators.
123104: Anguished cries and grim laughter never cease in the Cliff of Chaos. Victory, defeat, bloodshed, death, taunting, plundering, conflict, apathy... these all exist in this lawless world. The huge whirling vortex that has anchored itself at the highest point of the Cliff of Chaos may also represent its denizens, who sink ever deeper into chaos.
123105: It is uncertain where the entrance to the Cliff of Chaos is, records only note its approximate location. Only a few lost travelers have seen it. Narcia is replete with people dreaming of the chance to catch a glimpse. What they don't know is that the Cliff of Chaos, much like a monster that is hungry yet picky, is difficult to enter and leave. All who enter may find themselves trapped forever.
123106: The Grief Harpist's melody rings day and night on the Cliff of Chaos. He weaves the legends of tragic heroes from the Cliff of Chaos into melancholic tunes. Could these heroes be of his making?
123108: The Cloister of Learning is one of the Orderbound's three divine places. Apart from little conflicts deemed too small for concern, the place had not experienced war in a long time. Every overseer of the Cloister was instrumental in providing its residents peaceful lives, though their methods could raise eyebrows. A previous overseer’s greatest achievement was distributing his “Delicacies for the Learned” compilation across Narcia during his tenure. As for Despotic Maestro, his practise was conducting “Sonata of the Learned” with his orchestra once a day, believing the beautiful melody kept everyone’s spirits up. News of war arrived when Despotic Maestro was immersed in the Sonata’s dramatic climax. That day, the music stopped abruptly. "Annihilators." Despotic Maestro’s usual stoic expression gave way to seething anger upon reading the report. Frowning, he placed the missive on the rostrum before raising his baton again. "It's been a while since I last conducted a battle."
123109:
Catty Spirit is astounded by the well-trained army in front of it. All residents of the Cloister of Learning are accustomed to a leisurely lifestyle. Never in a million years would the stubborn cat spirit expect someone here to train an army. 
Ignoring Catty Spirit's surprise, Cosmic Pugilist continues to address the crowd, his voice loud and clear throughout the Cloister. 
"...I believe in preparing for danger even in times of peace. We stand a better chance of victory now that war is imminent." 
He awaits Despotic Maestro's reply, but the latter simply responds with a soft snort. 
The nonchalant response enrages Cosmic Pugilist. He believes discipline and strength are needed to survive the turbulent times ahead. And these are the very qualities the Cloister of Learning's lifestyle has eradicated. 
"What do you mean by that?!" He roars. 
Only then does Despotic Maestro speak, "I don't care why you're secretly training an army. It is certainly helpful considering the current power dynamics." He pauses to glance at Cosmic Pugilist, almost savoring the sight of the latter's rage. "Whatever it is, there is only one thing that matters: from now on, I will command this army."
123110: Despotic Maestro and Cosmic Pugilist are incompatible lately, like fire and water. The Cloister's overseer wants to manage and control every aspect of the place, but Cosmic Pugilist, the army's founder, is vehemently against it. Spartan Spearman thinks Cosmic Pugilist is either lazy or he's discontented with reporting to a superior he's at odds with. He's unfazed by the conflict brought out by Despotic Maestro's and Cosmic Pugilist's personality differences. To him, those two big shots are simply overthinking matters. What does matter is the huge Annihilator army that threatens the entire realm of Narcia. Spartan Spearman pulls the tip of his spear out of one of the many corpses around him, all of whom were famed and dangerous generals of the Annihilator army. One thing Spartan Spearman can get behind is Despotic Maestro and Cosmic Pugilist's complete approval of him leading the vanguard. So it's really not that complicated. Everyone here wants the Cloister of Learning to prevail. Everyone here wants to defeat the Annihilators. That's all Spartan Spearman needs to know to be ready to charge forth with a spear in each hand.
123112:
"Whoo--" it called out in a low groan.
"Whoo--" "Whoo--" "Whoo--" multiple voices responded.
"Roar--" it shouted.
"Roar--" "Roar--" "Roar--" multiple voices returned its cry.
It understood there were countless like it here. But where was "here"?
It recalled its creation… an amalgamation of ash, rock fragments, corroded weapons, rotten corpses, and a peculiar dim flame.
It remembered appearing in those ruins from the dim flame. It wondered what it was. A piece of junk? A monster? A human…?
No, not a human, it thought. Humans were what attacked it and called it the Primeval Golem. Certainly it was a monster from the Simmering Ruins.
The Primeval Golem looked around, observing other creatures in the ruins wandering aimlessly. No humans were in sight, for it had scared them away. It was unhurt from the attack, safe from a little cut.
The sensation of pain coming from the little cut frightened it, just like everything - including its own existence - did. As it curled itself into a ball, tentacles stretched out over it.
Tentacles?! Why did its body grow tentacles?
It curled up even more tightly, consumed with fear.
123113:
The place and the power it possessed excited Merksha greatly. 
She watched as the Simmering Ruins produced a powerful monster after consuming a sea god's severed tentacle, pieces of internal organs, and some miscellaneous junk.
It was testament to the power of the ruins. Merksha was convinced after she witnessed its creation of the Primeval Golem.
Countless other creatures, created by the same process, shambled across the ruins. Some fast-moving figures seemed to be guiding the horde somewhere.
There were more secrets to be discovered. How interesting, she thought. And she loved secrets. 
Merksha grinned in anticipation. Little did she know her excitement would soon be replaced by boundless darkness and silence...
123114:
Hex Painter unfurls her scroll and starts drawing with her ink brush, her expression serious. She draws a picture of herself, accurately depicting her terrible complexion and eyes encircled by dark eyeliner. She finishes by curving the ends of her eyes upward. She loves her femme fatale look, believing it befits her status as a general of the Annihilators. However, she has no love at all for the Simmering Ruins. The air is pungent, it's crawling with grotesque monsters, and there's always something wet and sticky around. She frowns discontentedly. "This place is the worst. Why did I have to be assigned here...?" 
The legion's plan to invade Narcia hasn't gone smoothly. They did not expect the lords of Narcia to band together and form a consolidated defense.
Which led to her getting sent to this horrid place...
Unlike her, many within the Annihilators enjoy the Simmering Ruins. A flaming rock sits at the center, absorbing everything around it to create almost unlimited forms of monsters. Hex Painter's mission is to draft these monsters into the Annihilator army.
Hex Painter completely hates her task. In fact, she has no love for the Annihilators either. The terror and destruction they caused have left her exhausted and filled her with self-hate.
She thinks to herself, maybe she can turn the situation around. Perhaps she herself or even the Destined Alliance can use these creatures instead. She watches the monsters as they are created from the flaming rock and draws each of them on her scroll.
With a plan in her mind, Hex Painter's boredom is replaced by excitement.
123116: The rules in the Hall of Wisdom are not as rigid as the Lawful Summit's, nor as lax as the Cloister of Learning's. Hence, the Hall often takes the role as moderator for the other two. The heroes in the Hall of Wisdom are pleased to learn that both the Lawful Summit and the Cloister of Learning are joining the war against the Annihilators. They are heartened that both sides have stepped out of their respective traditional mindsets to arrive at the same decision. Perhaps this war is the chance to change the rules that have defined the three areas for so long.
123117: The Sword Sage releases thousands of swords into the air. Sharp blades brush past Jewellee's dazzling Jewel Bomb, their glint coating the Flower Fae's rose and Flutterelle's bow in a thin layer of gold. The Dragon Scholar blows his gilded horn to call forth the dragon in the Hall of Wisdom to join the assembly. Brilliant sunlight shines upon the heroes, filling them with hope. No one is afraid of the impending war against the Annihilators.
123118:
There is more to a war than clashing weapons with your foes. In those being protected, it invokes a determination to become stronger and hopes of a better life after the war.
"That’s why I want to plant flowers there." Flower Fae said while pointing at the smoke plumes in the distance. Another village has fallen to the Annihilators. "Of course I will call upon the surviving villagers to plant seeds, rebuild their homes, and renew their hopes for the future."
123120:
Dark purple shadows swirl around the altar like thick clouds. A great eye can be seen among the shadows... the Annihilators are creating an Omniscient Eye!
Once it's complete, all of Narcia's secrets will be revealed to the Annihilators, making them even more difficult to defeat.
For now, countless Annihilator generals, supervisors, and slaves have swarmed the Omniscient Altar, frustratingly, to build the second Eye (the first attempt collapsed halfway through its construction). This second attempt is faring better, but the Annihilators wonder if the Eye's clairvoyance will be blocked by the thick shadows that have settled around it.
They have tried using various means, from using strong winds to elemental magic, to disperse the shadows. But none has succeeded.
Fortunately for the Annihilators, the Omniscient Eye's construction is a tightly held secret, and remains undiscovered by Narcia's lords and heroes.
123121:
The construction of the Omniscient Eye is not a secret. After the Annihilators invaded Narcia and set up bases, the Heroes of Narcia began exploring the continent under the leadership of their lords. They hunted down Annihilator nests and discovered the Omniscient Altar.
The Omniscient Altar is of great importance to the Annihilators and therefore heavily guarded. It's not easy for the Heroes of Narcia to take this place down. They pretend not to know of its existence to avoid alarming the Annihilators, but they can't let the Omniscient Eye's construction continue either.
Heroes have been infiltrating it and secretly sabotaging the construction plans. Others have even gone undercover not only to interrupt the construction, but also to stop the the Annihilators' evil plan of conquering Narcia.
123122:
A deafening explosion rippled outwards as the Annihilators' painstakenly-built Omniscient Eye collapsed. The thick smoke and dust clouds that lingered above the Omniscient Altar did naught to mask the garrisoned Annihilators' disappointment—their plan to construct a second Omniscient Eye was once again foiled by the Heroes of Narcia.
However, the Archdemon responded swiftly to order the construction of a third "Eye". And this time, he'll be deploying elite troops to guard the Omniscient Altar...
123125:
As the disaster caused by the Annihilators swept across Narcia, the Heroes joined forces to defend the land. But in face of the enemy onslaught, some Narcian forces and Heroes foresaw it would turn into a drawn-out war.
To ensure constant support for the war against the Annihilators, some forces of Narcia decided to establish several academies and research centers. The Spiritual Academy is one of them, located between the Dawn Empire and the Rocky Sierra.
123126:
When the Spiritual Academy was first established, things did not go as planned.
On one hand, it suffered repeated attacks from the Annihilators who attempted to disrupt the Heroes building new forces. On the other hand, there was also a sizable amount of people in Narcia who disagreed with establishing the Spiritual Academy on such short notice. They felt the resources should go to keeping the war short instead of being diverting toward preparing for a continued war in the years to come.
With continued external attacks and a lack of internal support, the Spiritual Academy was almost not built.
123127:
It was only until Mystrix accepted the role of academy director at Athene's request that the Spiritual Academy proceeded smoothly. Mystrix was highly-respected and knowledgeable, and had planned to compile the full history of Narcia. But the sudden outbreak of war forced him to put his work aside to manage the Spiritual Academy.
Mystrix's reputation attracted admirers. Besides those who came to learn, a Hero retreated from the frontline to become Guard Captain of the Spiritual Academy. With him around, the Annihilators could no longer foil the academy's establishment. The academy eventually played a part in nurturing several great Heroes, proving that establishing it was the right decision.
123128: People don't have tend to have a good first impression of the Dark Mudflat's murky shore and the putrid, clammy wind from the sea. Their second impression isn't any better. Upon closer inspection, beneath the black mud lies trash as well as the severed limbs and skulls of humans and animals. The stench in the air is not that of sea water, but of the corpses trapped in the mud. Once a clean, pure coast, it has been ravaged by the activities of the merfolk.
123129: The merfolk consist of creatures that emerged from an ancient beast that sleeps in the abyss, and the original sea creatures whose physical forms and abilities have been altered by beast's aura. Although all merfolk draw life and power from this beast, their attitudes towards it vary greatly. Some merfolk fear the day the beast awakens, believing that would herald a disaster. But others will stop at nothing to awaken what they regard as their great creator.
123130: Recently, the faction of merfolk that regards the ancient beast as their great creator has applied increasingly bizarre and evil methods in their attempt to awaken it. These fanatical merfolk have been capturing all manner of creatures from the coast for a ritual to revive the beast. Even a huge dragon has fallen into the hands of these crazed merfolk...

133002:
1. Every Season lasts 7 days. Guilds in the top 10,000 of the Guild Might rankings may register. Guild members can register upon reaching 10,000 Might, but their guild can only join the event if the Guild Leader or Vice Leader registers, and there are at least 5 registrants. 84 hours after registration starts, successfully registered Guilds will be placed in an event battlefield. Battlefields will hold multiple hostile Guilds.
2. Players may select up to 30 Heroes every season. You may change your selections before the season starts. When the event begins, players can form up to 3 teams to deploy. Teams may hold up to 6 Heroes.
3. In this event, Heroes have a "Strength" attribute (the purple meter below the Hero's Portrait). Heroes starts with 100 Strength. Marches and battles will lower Hero Strength, which decrease the Hero's HP and ATK. Heroes garrisoned in Town Tiles can be added or removed from your teams, and their Hero Strength can be restored. Heroes garrisoned in Resource Tiles cannot perform these actions.
4. Players will not have individual bases, but will have a Guild Fortress which cannot be attacked. Guild members can deploy teams from, and return to, their Guild Fortress. Using the Guild Fortress as their base, Guild members must expand their territory by deploying teams to occupy adjacent Tiles. Occupy Small and Large Towns to advance toward the ultimate goal: the Imperial Castle in the center of the map. Once a Guild successfully occupies the Imperial Castle, the Guild's Imperial Castle Score will continue to increase the longer they occupy the Imperial Castle.
5. Farmland, Lake, and Mine Tiles produce Food, Water, and Ore respectively. Food is used to restore Hero Strength. Water is required for your teams to march. Ore is used to level up Towns.
6. Your Guild earns Guild Points based on the quantity and levels of Tiles your Guild occupies. However, the corresponding Guild points are lost when your Guild no longer occupies those tiles.
7. Earn Solo Points when you battle other Guilds, occupy tiles, or donate Ore to level up Towns. At the start of every hour, Town tiles will also grant Solo Points.
8. Results will be processed after the Season ends. Guilds cannot increase their Imperial Castle Score or gain resources while results are being processed.
9. At the end of the event, rewards will be issued to each Guild based on their cumulative Imperial Castle Score, Guild Points, and Solo Points.
10. Guilds may occupy up to 1,500 Tiles.
11. 20s after each Narcia: War Era battle begins, DMG received by each unit is increased by 200%, and will continue to increase once every 10s until the battle ends.

1. Deploy Heroes to undertake Gear Tasks. When the time of a task is up, you will receive Gear as a reward. 
2. Gear Tasks reset daily at 00:00 server time. You can spend Gems to refresh tasks you haven't started on.
3. Increase the Gear Hub's level for it to produce more daily Gear Tasks and raise the lowest difficulty (depicted as each task's Star level) available.
4. Tasks of each Star level require Heroes of a specified grade, Star Level, and Faction to complete. Every Hero may only undertake one Gear Task at a time. (You can use duplicate Heroes to undertake different Gear Tasks at the same time.)

160457:
1. Every piece of Gear has three attributes: Grade, Level, and Star Level.
2. There are a total of 5 different grades. From lowest to highest order: Inferior (white), Ordinary (green), Elite (blue), Legendary (purple), and Epic (orange). A higher grade Gear has higher Max Level and Max Star Level, but requires more EXP to upgrade.
3. Enhance a piece of Gear and raise its Level by consuming Gear Enhance Rocks or other pieces of Gear. 
4. Raise Gear's Star Level by consuming other pieces of Gear. Gear to be consumed must be of a lower grade than the piece for which you want to raise the Star Level. You can also raise Gear's Max Star Level when you reach certain Gear Levels. 
5. Combine 2 pieces of Gear at Max Star Level, Max Level, and of the same grade to get 1 random piece of Gear one grade higher.

165007:
1. Head into the unearthly realm and lead a new lineup against the enemy forces! 
2. Select a stage to proceed to the Preparation page. Select your lineup, then start the battle.
3. Placing Heroes, troops, or Spells during battle consumes Magic Ability. The amount of Magic Ability required differs for different Heroes, troops, and Spells. You gain Magic Ability over time.
4. Use the countering relationships between different Heroes, troops, and Spells to win battles more easily. (The countering relationships are shown at the bottom of the page.)
5. Destroy the enemy castle within the given time to win the battle. The battle results in a loss if you fail to destroy the enemy castle within the time or if your castle is destroyed (it will also result in a loss if the battle is paused for more than 9 minutes).
6. You will win a Chest for every battle won. Each Chest will be locked for a certain amount of time before it can be opened. Chests may contain Heroes, troops, and Spells you can use in the unearthly realm.
- Chest I (Green, unlocks in 15 minutes): chance to obtain 3 Elite Heroes, troops, or Spells.
- Chest II (Blue, unlocks in 1 hour): chance to obtain 5 Legendary Heroes, troops, or Spells.
- Chest III (Purple, unlocks in 3 hours): chance to obtain 10 Legendary Heroes, troops, or Spells.
7. When you clear each stage for the first time, in addition to a Chest, you may also win other rewards such as Hero Coins and Gems. Any rewards that are not from a Chest will be sent to your mailbox.
8. You can consume your unearthly realm Heroes, troops, and Spells in the specified amounts for upgrading. Upgrading improves the target's attributes.

174057:
I) Event introduction
Each season starts at the beginning of the month and is held over 11 days. Players who successfully register for this server event will send 3 teams to battle. Fight and advance through the Breakout Phase, Preliminary Phase, and Final Phase to claim the World Ruler crown! Players who don't register for the season may take part in Ruler Prediction during the Final Phase!

II) Event registration
1. Event registration is open from the 1st to the 2nd day of each season. Players with 53,000 Might and above may register for the event.
2. You can select and register for a competition that suits your Might.
You will receive a registration reward immediately after successfully registering. Check your mailbox for the actual items sent.
3. Upon successful registration, you can spend Gems to change your entry. However, you will not receive another registration reward.
4. If 256 or more registrants are obtained during the registration period, the season will officially start on the 3rd day. Once the registration period is over, all registrants will be assigned to various divisions of the corresponding competitions.
5. The season will be canceled if there are fewer than 256 registrants.

III) Breakout Phase
1. The Breakout Phase will be held over 2 days. Registrants may participate in this phase.
2. Battle in a total of 15 matches (to win a match, players must win 2 out of the 3 rounds in the match). Earn 10 Points for each match you win. Earn 3 Points for each match you lose. Earn extra Points if you achieve a winning streak. Reach the specified amount of Points to receive the corresponding Tier rewards in your mailbox.
3. The top 256 participants in the rankings at the end of the Breakout Phase will qualify for the Preliminary Phase. If multiple participants obtained the same amount of Points, the participant who obtained the score earliest will be ranked higher.
4. Tier and Breakout Phase rewards will be sent to the player's mailbox after the phase ends.
5. Rankings will be refreshed every 3 hours.

IV) Preliminary Phase
1. The Preliminary Phase will be held over 2 days. The 256 participants who qualify will be divided into 16 groups. The 16 participants in each group will be randomly matched with an opponent. To advance, players must win 2 out of the 3 rounds in each match. The top player of each group will qualify for the Final Phase.
2. Preliminary Phase rewards will be sent to the player's mailbox after the phase ends.

V) Ruler Prediction
1. After the end of the Preliminary Phase, players who have obtained the Title of Grand Duke II or above may participate in Ruler Prediction in the King Stage. Predict the 1st Place winner among the participants who have qualified for the Final Phase to win great rewards!
2. You can only submit division predictions for the King Stage.
3. You can spend Gems to buy a Predict Pack and make a prediction for the corresponding placing. Gems spent to purchase Predict Packs will be added to the Final Phase prize pool for the respective division. The prize pools of each division are independent of each other.
4. Once the Final Phase 1st Place winner is determined, rewards from the prize pool will be distributed (based on a certain percentage) among the players who made the correct prediction. The maximum number of Gems you can receive is 20x the amount spent on making the prediction. The Predict Reward will be sent to the player's mailbox after the Final Phase ends.

VI) Final Phase
1. The Final Phase will be held over 2 days. The top player from each group in the Preliminary Phase will battle in 1v1 matches. To advance, the player must win 2 out of the 3 rounds in each match. The top players in this phase will become the champion of their respective divisions.
2. Rewards based on Final Phase ranking will be sent to the player's mailbox after the phase ends. Every season, the top 4 players in the King Stage and the 1st Place winners in the Advanced Stage and the Novice Stage will win exclusive portrait frames. (Go to the frames interface to view them.) 

VII) Other rules
1. Participants who qualify for the Preliminary Phase and Final Phase may change their Hero lineups on the 5th and 8th of each season respectively. The Hero lineups cannot be changed once the Preliminary Phase/Final Phase commences.
2. Please do not consume or destroy any Heroes you are using in the event before the event ends, as this may affect the user experience.
3. Ruler Archive: the Ruler Archive records the top 4 players of every season's King Stage, and top 4 players of the previous season's Advanced Stage and Novice Stage. The Ruler Archive is updated after the end of each season.
4. Auto-Registering: buying the World Ruler event Perk allows you to auto-register for the event for 5 consecutive seasons. Automatic registration will be canceled if your Might exceeds the registered competition's Might limit. You will have to check the box again.
5. Once 20 seconds have elapsed from the start of the battle, units will begin to sustain 200% more damage. After that, the damage sustained increases once every 10 seconds until the battle ends.
6. In the first 2 rounds of each Preliminary and Final Phase match, participants will be assigned to be the attacker and defender for one round each. In the final third round, participants will be assigned as the attacker or defender at random.

1. Gameplay Introduction
In this land abandoned by the gods comes new gameplay and rules. Players need to recruit and train Heroes again to resist enemy attacks in the Forsaken Land.

2. Battle Details 
1) Win Condition: Deploy 6 Heroes on the battlefield and kill monsters that appear from the spawn point. To win, defeat all waves of monsters before time runs out. If the total Monster Value on the battlefield exceeds the limit, or if there are monsters still remaining after time runs out, the challenge will result in [Defeat]. (Each type of monster carries a different Monster Value: Grunts carry a value of 1, Elite Monsters carry a value of either 2 or 3, and Bosses carry a value of 8.)
2) Monster Details: Monsters will attack from the spawn point in waves. The Bosses, Elite Monsters, and Grunts will move in a loop along the path. While they can’t attack, they may have other skills, such as the ability to stun Heroes, possess high Dodge, etc.
3) Additional Waves: During the battle, players can manually activate additional waves. Upon activation, an extra wave of monsters will immediately appear at the spawn point. There is a cooldown after each activation, and up to 5 additional waves can be activated for each battle.
4) Upgrade Options: During the battle, Heroes can receive some passive effects, which grant them temporary enhancements for the current challenge. These effects can be upgraded within the current challenge, but they will disappear after the battle ends.
- Players can get Player EXP by killing monsters in battle. After leveling up, they gain a passive effect.
- Killing a Boss grants you a chance to open the Forsaken Chest on the right. Opening a Forsaken Chest grants 1-5 passive effects.
- When a Hero reaches 5 Stars during a single challenge, you can choose to Evolve them the next time your upgrade options are refreshed. The Hero must have a specific passive effect as a prerequisite to Evolve. When such passive effects appear in as an upgrade option, they will display the [Evolve Prerequisite] label and the corresponding Hero.

3. Hero Details:
1) Only specific Heroes can be used in Forsaken Land, and some Heroes can only be used after certain conditions are met. Due to the Forsaken Land's influence, the Heroes' abilities have undergone some changes.
2) Heroes can be trained and leveled up with Hero EXP gained from completing challenge stages and Patrols.

4. Reward Details:
1) After winning a challenge stage, the deployed Heroes will receive rewards such as Forsaken Hero EXP, Endowment Stones, and possibly Fireling Stones!
2) Complete Stage L1 to unlock a Patrol Reward, which is based on the highest stage currently completed and Patrol duration. Rewards include Forsaken Hero EXP, Endowment Stones, and possibly Fireling Stones!

1. Each season lasts for 7 days. Guilds ranked in the top 2,496 can participate in this event. Guild members must have 20,000 Might or more to participate.
2. Initially, Guilds will be positioned in battlefields of different levels according to certain rules. Guilds that obtain a high ranking in each season will be promoted to a higher level battlefield in the next season, while Guilds that rank low will be downgraded to a lower level battlefield. At the end of the season, the top ranking Guild in the highest level battleground will be proclaimed the Strongest Guild of the season.
3. After the season opens, players need to form Defense Teams and Attack Teams. Defense Teams can only be formed during the Defense Team Creation period, which is within 36 hours after the opening of the season. After the Defense Team Creation period ends and before battles begin, Guild Leaders will need to deploy players with Defense Teams as Garrisons in various Buildings. This is called the Defense Layout period. Garrisons cannot be changed once an opponent is matched. After the end of the Defense Layout period, the Guild enters a 4-day battle period, during which an opponent will be matched every day according to specified rules.
4. In each battlefield, Guilds with the same win streaks will be randomly matched to each other. Each battle lasts for 1 day.
5. During the battle, attack the other Guild's Buildings and destroy their Main City to gain Guild Points and win. To attack other Buildings in a City, you must first destroy the City's Gates. Each Gate provides a different boost to the Garrisons within the City (these boosts don't apply to the Gates themselves). To attack a Garrison Stronghold, you must first destroy every Fortress around it. To attack the Main City, you must first destroy one other City.
6. Each time you attack a Building, you will fight with the Garrison stationed at that Building. A certain amount of Building Durability will be consumed, depending on the result of the attack. The attacking player gains Solo Points according to the Building Durability consumed and the Garrison's Might ranking. When a Building's Durability is 0, the Building is destroyed, and the attacking Guild gains a certain amount of Guild Points. When all Buildings in a City (these exclude the City's Gates) are destroyed, the City is deemed captured and the attacking Guild gains a large amount of Guild Points. 
7. When a Building's Durability is not full, the Garrison in the Building is weakened.
8. The side that captures their enemy's Main City will be declared the winner, while the side that has their Main City captured will be declared the loser. This applies to both your Guild and your opponent. If this condition isn't met to determine a winner, the Guild with fewer Guild Points will be declared the loser.
9. You will receive Prestige every time you use an attack attempt. During periods when you can't use attack attempts to attack enemy Buildings, the unused attempts will be converted into points, and you will receive Prestige.
10. At the end of the season, Solo Ranking Rewards will be awarded according to your Solo Points ranking within your Guild, and Guild Rewards will be awarded to Guilds according to their battlefield level and the number of battles won. You must have more than 100 Solo Points for the season to receive Solo rewards and Guild rewards.

192502:
1. Tap and use Ordinary Dice to roll a random number between 1 and 6, and move the corresponding squares on the map. Use Lucky Dice to roll a specified number.
2. When you move to a square, you can get the corresponding boost or activate the corresponding effect.
3. Special squares:
- Start Square: The game starts and ends on this square. Each time you pass this square, you'll gain 10 Fragrant Buns, 1 Practice Missive, and Lap +1.
- Attribute boosts: Some squares award ATK, HP, CRIT DMG, CRIT Rate, or ACC boosts. If you land on such a square, you'll gain the corresponding attribute boost, and the square's Lv will be raised by 1. This Lv cannot be further raised when it has reached its max Lv.
- Accumulated Fragrant Buns: If you land on this square, you obtain the number of Fragrant Buns accumulated on the square. The number of Fragrant Buns on the square will then be increased by 1. Up to 15 Fragrant Buns can be accumulated on the square.
- Random Card: If you land on this square, you can choose one of 3 Cards to gain the corresponding effect.
- Portal: If you land on this, you will be teleported to the Start Square and receive the Start Square's effects.
- Dice Game: If you land on this square, you'll receive three chances to throw two dice at the same time (this does not consume the dice you own). If both dice land on the same number, you win Ordinary Dice equal to that number.
- Mystical Scroll: If you land on this square, a specified Hero will gain a powerful attribute boost.
- Increased Offensive: If you land on this square, the attacking team will gain attribute boosts according to the attributes' Lv on the current map.
4. Kung Fu Practice: In Kung Fu Practice, players will be assigned to a 5-player Practice leaderboard every day. Results will be tallied on the leaderboard and players will be re-grouped daily (excluding the last day). Consume a Practice Missive to practice against other adventurers, and win Fragrant Buns and points. In a Practice match, the attacking team is set by the system. The system will automatically deploy Po, and other Heroes, Talents, Square Insignias, Round Insignias, Enchantments, and Pets that the player owns and have the most Might.
5. When using the Auto function, if you land on a Random Card square, a random Effect Card will be automatically selected. If you land on a Dice Game square, the dice will be automatically thrown, and the game will continue until you run out of dice or when you stop using the Auto function.
6. The Quick Throw function will be activated when throwing over 100 Ordinary Dice. When using the Quick Throw function, 10 dice will be thrown together each time, and you will instantly receive the corresponding rewards and boosts. During the process, Effect Cards will be automatically selected and the Dice Game will be automatically played until you stop throwing the dice.
7. On the last day of the event, you may only view Lap Rankings, exchange for rewards, and draw Keepsakes (no group Ranking Rewards will be given out yet).
8. After the event ends, Ranking Rewards will be issued according to your Lap Ranking. In cases where the number of Laps is the same, the player who reached the final number of Laps first will be ranked higher. Ordinary Dice, Lucky Dice, Fragrant Buns, Practice Missives, etc. will be reset to zero after the event.
